fields.Name: T255 - Knowledge Visualize Mode Toggle
fields.Description: Exercises the Visualize host's mode toggle (SelectMode) that conditionally mounts the embedded cluster component vs the tag-cloud component — a distinct view-switch code path.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Knowledge Hub app via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, then click 'Visualize' in the left nav (fa-circle-nodes icon). The Visualize screen has a mode switch in its toolbar with two tabs (Clusters and Tag Cloud). Confirm the default mode renders its visualization, then click the other mode and confirm the main area swaps to that visualization. Success is that toggling the mode switches between the cluster scatter view and the tag cloud view (an empty/loading visualization for either mode still counts as the mode rendering). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Visualize screen loads with a mode switch offering Clusters and Tag Cloud
Clicking the alternate mode swaps the main area to that visualization (cluster scatter vs tag cloud), each rendering or showing a valid empty/loading state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
